1.consolidated_definition: Planta enredadera cuyas hojas triangulares están formadas por diminutos filamentos verdes. Se emplea mucho para la decoración. Por su aspecto delicado, en algunas poblaciones la llaman encaje y en otras ala de pájaro. (Asparagus plumosus, Baker).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Vine climbing plant whose triangular leaves are formed by minute green filaments. It is used extensively for decoration. Due to its delicate appearance, it is sometimes referred to as lace in certain populations and bird's wing in others (Asparagus plumosus, Baker).
